name: As the Crow Flies
summary: Elaena asks you to meet a dear friend at the summit in Hyjal. The meeting awaits up the eastern road.

sections.title: A Meeting Above
sections.body: Elaena’s friend waits at the summit in Hyjal, and you are asked to meet her there. The road east leads toward the meeting.

sections.title: At the Summit
sections.body: At the summit, Elaena’s friend greets you and says you have earned a reputation there. She is pleased to meet you at last.

faq.q: Who am I supposed to meet?
faq.answer: You are asked to meet a dear friend of Elaena at the summit in Hyjal.
The meeting is at the summit in Hyjal, up the road to the east.

faq.q: What does Elaena ask me to do?
faq.answer: Elaena asks you to meet her friend at the summit in Hyjal.

attribution: In-game quest text: As the Crow Flies
